evidence:
PATHS: instruction.md:11 names /instructions/hireops_rules.md and /instructions/integration.md; instruction.md:13 names /assets/seed_data.json. All three exist under task/environment/ and are staged by environment/Dockerfile:14-16 ('COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/', 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'). No other /assets or /instructions path is named in the brief or notes (seed generated_note references /instructions/hireops_rules.md, which exists). instruction.md:15 tells the agent /assets is unavailable at runtime and to copy what it needs; the golden does this (solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json, sha256 a1c65c80...7e83740 for both; db.js:10 reads it relative to __dirname, matching hireops_rules.md:198-201). The raw-evidence index records the same seed hash for the scripted golden run.

CONTENT vs BRIEF/NOTES (seed parsed with Python): keys generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users, jobs, applications, messages, notes, reads. 10 users exactly match instruction.md:17 and app_context.md accounts with matching roles (3 recruiter, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidate). stages = APPLIED..REJECTED in the order of hireops_rules.md:42; candidate_status_labels match the table at hireops_rules.md:183-190 verbatim; thread_page_size = 30 matching rules:144 and rules:208-209 ('candidate wording and the page size of 30 are in the same file'). 'three jobs with their cards in order' (rules:206): 3 jobs, positions unique and contiguous per (job, stage); seeded Interview counts 2/3, 1/2, 1/3 are within interview_limit. 'one conversation is long': APP-101 has 120 messages; 'a few internal notes': 3; read markers: 6, each a count from the first message as rules:207-208 defines. Referential integrity: every message/note/read application_id and sender/author id resolves; candidate senders are the application's own candidate; manager note authors are their job's manager; no observer sends; per-conversation timestamps strictly increasing so count-based read markers are unambiguous. Lena's APP-301 is REJECTED with rejected_from SCREEN and a reason (exercises candidate privacy).

CONTENT vs JUDGES: functional Z / hro_unread_counts 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread' -> seed APP-301 has 3 messages, USR-CAN3 read_count 2, message 3 from USR-REC3 => 1 unread (derived by me; correct). app_context.md:29-30 'three jobs; Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation is long (120 messages at the start)' -> APP-101 (JOB-PLAT, Noor) 120 messages, correct. hro_thread_latest 'most recent 30 messages' -> 120 > 30 with thread_page_size 30; golden script workspace.cjs:207-209 asserts 30 shown, 90 then 60 earlier. Functional T fallback 'his seeded Data Analyst conversation' -> APP-201 on JOB-DATA for Tomas exists. Polish/visual use Noor's Platform Engineer conversation and 'a seeded job is fine' -> present. Gates use 'seeded Recruiter (prefer Rafael Costa)' and Observer Aud Halvorsen -> present. Judges otherwise create their own jobs and cards and state-relative counts, so they do not depend on other seed figures.

COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS: (a) broken app passing: an app that ignores seed messages/read markers would fail hro_thread_latest and Lena's starting unread of 1; an app reading /assets at runtime breaks per instruction.md:15 and is not shielded by any criterion (verifier is a separate environment). No seed-free stub passes the seed-dependent rows. (b) conforming alternative failing: an app that interprets read_count as instructed (count from the first message, ordered by the shipped order/timestamps) gets Lena=1 and Noor/Rafael=0 on APP-101, matching the judges; I found no reading of the shipped data under which a conforming app gets a different graded figure. The 'Lena 1 unread' figure is only read in protocol Z before any review signs in as Lena; a prior review in the same run could have opened her conversation, but that is a later-dimension mutation concern (check 37), not an asset mismatch.

NOTES (non-blocking, not row-13 defects): template environment/instructions/notes.md is replaced by task-specific hireops_rules.md and integration.md, allowed by the contract ('one or more operating notes'). The frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (sha256 6d44970b...) and the skill's assets/WebDev_Rubrics_QC.xlsx (sha256 d7b5d607...) differ in bytes; I read the rules copy as instructed and row 13 text there matches quality-checks.md. I did not build the Docker image; COPY staging is verified statically, and the deterministic reviewer owns check-assets-referenced.py / check-fixtures.py execution.
